{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.00) to correct for overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when price is trending downward, as models tend to overreact.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is > 10% above forecast 3-5 days later, adjust forecast upward by 5-10% to account for delayed reaction.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 15% above recent high — avoid overshoot after sharp rallies.",
    "When sentiment turns positive (sentiment > 0.00), increase forecast by 3-5% to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 20% above prior peak.",
    "In low volatility regimes (e.g., < 2% daily range), reduce forecast spread to avoid overfitting to noise.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 5-10% to avoid downward bias."
  ]
}
